qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M8 screws on the rubber mount to front axle carrier?
What torque should I use for M10 screws on the rubber mount to engine console?
What are the two different screw sizes used for the engine console to engine mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 screws (22 Nm) and M10 screws (47 Nm)

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M8 screws on the engine console to engine mounting?
How many different mounting points are covered in the Engine Suspension section 11 81?
qa_pairs.answer: Three mounting points: rubber mount to front axle carrier (1AZ), rubber mount to engine console (2AZ), and engine console to engine (3AZ)

qa_pairs.question: Is there a difference in M8 screw torque between the front axle carrier mount and engine console mount?
qa_pairs.answer: No, both use M8 screws with 22 Nm torque specification

qa_pairs.question: What is the highest torque specification shown for engine suspension mountings?
Which mounting point uses both M8 and M10 screws?
qa_pairs.answer: All three mounting points (1AZ, 2AZ, and 3AZ) use both M8 and M10 screws
